title: Yoroiden Samurai Troopers, Volume 1
originalTitle: 鎧伝サムライトルーパー　１巻
summary: The first BonBon manga volume differs sharply from the TV series: fewer individual hero episodes, thinner characterization for Seiji and Shin, Touma speaking politely as a strategist type, and unexpectedly cruel scenes of people dissolved, sealed into the Netherworld gate, and turned into monsters. The reviewer is surprised by how intense it is for a children's manga.
